title: Refer a Friend and Earn $$$
body:
Earn Rewards with Our Refer a Friend Program!

We’re excited to introduce our Refer a Friend program, where you can earn rewards simply by inviting others to sign up for our E-Box service.

How It Works:

1. Refer a Friend: Send your friends, colleagues, and relatives over to www.mbe.ky/e-box to sign up. When they pick up their first package, both you and your friend will each receive 1,000 MBE points—equivalent to $10 in savings.

2. Earn Rewards: For each friend you refer, you’ll earn 1,000 MBE points. Refer 10 friends, and that’s $100 to use towards your shipping fees!

3. Track Your Rewards: Once your friend picks up their first package, the 1,000 MBE points will be added to your account. Your friend will also get their 1,000 points as a welcome bonus!

Why Participate?

• Save More: 1,000 MBE points equals $10, so the more friends you refer, the more you save on shipping.
• Limited-Time Offer: This program ends on May 31st, 2025, so don’t miss out!
• Simple Process: Just give your friends your CBY number when they sign up, and we’ll make sure the points go to the right person when we contact them about the referral.

Start Referring Today!
Send your friends, colleagues, and relatives to www.mbe.ky/e-box and give them your CBY number so the points are applied correctly. The more you refer, the more you save on shipping!

Visit us at:
📍 Harbour Walk, Grand Harbour
📍 Camana Bay

We look forward to rewarding you and your friends. Feel free to reach out to us at info@mbe.ky if you have any questions!

title: Print from Phone
body:
Are your memories trapped in your phone between screenshots and recipes?

MBE Print from Phone service lets you turn your favorite pictures from your phone, into beautiful, printed photos in a matter of minutes!

No more scrolling through your camera roll and never printing those precious memories – now you can bring them to life instantly.

All you need to do is bring your phone with the photos you want to print to one of our stores. Our friendly staff will assist you in selecting the perfect shots and bringing them to life.

Our high-quality printers ensure that your photos are crisp, vibrant, and true to life, so you can cherish them for years to come.

Whether you’re looking to decorate your home with personalized photo prints, create a unique gift for a loved one, or simply want to preserve your memories in a tangible form, our Phone to Print service is the perfect solution. Say goodbye to digital clutter and hello to beautifully printed photos that you can enjoy and share with others.

Visit our stores today to experience the magic of our Print from Phone service and see your memories come to life in an instant.

title: E-box customers pay 0% Sales Tax on Amazon & ebay Purchases
body:
All e-box customers enjoy the benefit of not paying sales taxes in the USA on orders placed on Amazon and ebay. This is a unique benefit for Mail Boxes Etc. customers, representing up to 7% of savings on online purchases from these vendors. All you need to do is use your e-box address and make sure you include the complete zip code 33192-4177 when placing your order.

At MBE we are always looking for ways to provide cost-effective shipping solutions to our customers. This benefit was made possible through successful negotiations between Mail Boxes Etc. corporate and Florida state authorities in consideration of goods being exported out of the USA.

Don’t have an e-box account, visit our e-box page: www.mbe.ky/e-box

PACKAGES MUST LEAVE THE USA

In order to enjoy this tax-free benefit, it is a stipulation that all merchandise shipped to our e-box address in Miami must be exported to the Cayman Islands. The tax exemption benefit is granted on the premise that the goods are intended only for export and not intended for use within the United States. Consequently, it is not possible for customers to pick up packages from the E-Box office in Miami nor to redirect packages within the USA. Packages that cannot be exported must be returned to the supplier or otherwise discarded.

REFUND OF SALES TAX ALREADY PAID ON AMAZON ORDERS

This tax-exemption programme was initially instated in 2021 only for Amazon purchases however it was temporarily suspended between December 1, 2022 and June 1, 2023. If you are an e-box customer and you paid sales tax on any Amazon purchase shipped through e-box during this time, you may be eligible for a refund of the sales tax that you paid to Amazon. The refund process is done from your e-box account. Instructions on how to apply for a tax refund can be found by clicking the link below.

Important note: The tax exemption applies only to e-box air shipping and is linked specifically to the zip code 33192-4177. This means that the tax exemption does not apply to ocean cargo shipping which has a different address and zip code.

https://mbe.ky/e-box-amazon-tax-refund-program/

N.B. The sales tax exemption is not related to Cayman Islands Customs import duties, which continue to apply.

title: MBE at Harbour Walk is Now Open
body:
The ribbon is cut and MBE Cayman now has two locations to better serve our community! Our newest location at Harbour Walk is located in the Grand Harbour area, Red Bay and offers all of the services of our flagship store in Camana Bay.

Moving an existing e-box or mailbox account

Existing e-box customers wishing to move their e-box account to our new store at Harbour Walk may do so in one simple step. Visit our website mbe.ky/e-box and click the “Change my pick-up location” button to submit the request. The change will take effect in two business days. Customers can then begin collecting e-box packages from our Harbour Walk store and they can keep using the same CBY#.

Setting up a new e-box account

Customers interested in setting up a new e-box account for online shopping and shipping to the Cayman Islands should visit mbe.ky/e-box. Customers will select their preferred store when creating the account.

Physical and Virtual Mailboxes

New and existing customers wishing to have a local mailbox at Harbour Walk can submit their application online at www.mbe.ky/mailboxes. We offer traditional physical mailboxes with a key, as well as virtual mailboxes where you can view your mail with a mobile app and select actions on how you would like us to handle the mail. We regret that existing mailbox customers cannot keep the same mailbox number (i.e. address) when changing store location and a new mailbox number will be assigned.

Ocean shipping packages will continue to be collected from our Camana Bay store or via home delivery only.

We look forward to seeing you!
